blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hierarchical models have been proposed as synthetic settings for studying language. However, their relevance to realistic language corpora remains underexplored. In this work, we introduce tree-grams, autoregressive generative $n$-gram models that build the conditional probability tensor $p(x_n \mid x_{1:n-1})$ through a hierarchical composition of order-2 and order-3 tensors. $n$ controls the maximal context window, whereas a rank hyperparameter $d$ controls model capacity, yielding an interpretable and systematically scalable family of approximators of language. We show how tree-grams outperform existing $n$-gram baselines, while remaining competitive with deep transformer-based language models. We demonstrate the utility of such controlled approximations by using tree-grams as generative models. In particular, we show that hyperparameter transfer under $μ$P can be made more robust when narrower models are tuned on simpler data, generated by tree-grams with moderate $n$ and $d$. In addition, we show that entropy and effective range of correlations control performance gap after fine-tuning. This is because tree-grams allow us to explicitly control horizon and capacity. When allowed to route across candidate topologies, we observe emergent sparsity in tree-grams. Such concentrated routing permits pruning upto 95\% of topologies without significant change in performance.
blocks.zh: 分级模型被提出作为研究语言的合成设置. 然而,它们与现实语言corpora的相关性仍然没有得到充分的探讨. 在这部作品中,我们引入了树克,自相递回的基因元-克模型,通过顺序2和顺序3的分级组成来构建条件概率角(x_n\mid x_{1:n-1})$p. $n$控制最大上下文窗口,而分级高参数$d$控制模型容量,产生可解释和系统可扩展的语言近似家族. 我们显示树克如何超过现有的美元-克基线,同时保持与基于深变压器的语言模型的竞争力。 我们通过使用树克作为基因模型来证明这种有控制的近似值的效用。 特别是,我们表明,如果在较简单的数据上调取更窄的模型,用中度美元和德元的树克生成的多参数调取,那么在μ$P下的超参数调取可以更加有力。 此外,我们显示,在微调后,各种关联的有效范围可以控制性能差距。 这是因为树克使我们能够明确控制地平线和能力。 当被允许穿越候选地貌时,我们用树克观察出突发的孢子. 这种集中的路由可以使高达95个的地貌,而性能没有重大变化。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Language is hypothesized to be hierarchically structured ( Chomsky, 1956 ; Chomsky, 1957 ; Everaert et al., 2015 ; Hauser et al., 2002 ; Goodfellow et al., 2016 ) .
Its statistical structure has been studied using classical and modern language models, including Markov-chain and n n -gram models ( Shannon, 1951 ; Brown et al., 1992 ; Bengio et al., 2003a ) .
Synthetic datasets inspired by context-free gramars ( Chomsky, 1956 ; Hopcroft and Ullman, 1979 ; Klein and Manning, 2004 ; Kim et al., 2019 ) have also been proposed as tractable testbeds to understand language modeling.
In particular, ( Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) propose a family of tree-like generative models where a hierarchy of latent nodes determines the probability distribution of the leaves.
Tree-like generative models can successfully represent compositional dependencies and improve language modeling ( Dyer et al., 2016 ; Kuncoro et al., 2018 ) ; however, learning linguistically meaningful tree structures directly from data remains difficult ( Klein and Manning, 2004 ; Kim et al., 2019 ; Hewitt and Manning, 2019 ) . It is also important to understand what tree-like properties are present in real data, which can be accomplished by creating trainable versions of such models.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose such a trainable model. In particular, we propose tree-grams , which are hybrid n n -gram models based on hierarchy and local connectivity. Tree-grams combine order-2/order-3 tensor approximation with normalization layers, residual connections, and MLPs to approximate the order- n n transition tensor p ( x n | x 1 : n − 1 ) p(x_{n}|x_{1:n-1}) . The two hyper-parameters n n and d d are independent controls on tree-grams, while n n controls the horizon of the model, d d controls model capacity . A summary of our contributions is provided below.

• We present tree-grams as generative models for controlled approximation of language. The approximation is controlled through a horizon parameter n n and a rank parameter d d .
In contrast with context-free grammars, tree-grams learn the latent features from data.
We train tree-grams on TinyStories ( Eldan and Li, 2023 ) as a proof of concept, for which we demonstrate how tree-grams out-perform existing n n -gram estimators and remain competitive with deep neural references. • We demonstrate the utility of such controlled approximations by analyzing hyperparameter (HP) transfer and fine-tuning performance.
In particular, we show that HP transfer is more robust when the smaller proxy is trained on lower-complexity synthetic data.
We also investigate the effect of alignment between pre-training and finetuning data, where we show that performance has a stronger dependence on the finetuning distribution. • We observe concentrated topology-routing distributions when tree-grams are allowed to choose topologies at each layer through linear routers. We observe that the predictive performance changes very little even when we prune upto 95 % of topologies at each level. We emphasize that the value of tree-grams is experimental . It allows us to rigorously test ideas about the structure of (language) data and learning. This is in contrast with empirical value as a model class that out-performs SOTA neural networks. Thus the focus in this work was to set up a basic version of tree-like models that scale better than existing n n -gram baselines.

blocks.en: 1.1 Background and Motivation
blocks.zh: 1.1 背景和动机

blocks.en:
Hierarchical models have been used to study synthetic datasets resembling language. ( Chomsky, 1956 ; Chomsky and Schützenberger, 1963 ; Yao et al., 2021 ; Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) .
Justification for such hierarchical modelling comes from statistical property analysis ( Thurner et al., 2015 ) , information theory ( Futrell and Hahn, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) and
cognitive representations ( Crain and Nakayama, 1987 ; Pallier et al., 2011 ; Ding et al., 2016 ; Hale et al., 2018 ) .
However, all such models fix hidden features based on semantic or syntactic structures.
Tree-grams are introduced as generative models where the hidden node features are directly learnt from data.
In addition, it is useful to have independent knobs that control the complexity of the full corpus.
Such an approximation can be made by either controlling the capacity or the horizon of the generative model ( Cagnetta et al., 2026 ) .
Such approximations have been made by using traditional and smoothed n n -gram counts ( Chen and Goodman, 1996 ; Parikh et al., 2014a ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , hidden Markov models ( Balle et al., 2014 ) or tensor-trains ( Miller et al., 2021 ; Su et al., 2024 ) .
However, these methods are difficult to scale beyond few words.
On the other hand, the effect of various architectural hyper-parameters in transformers on model capacity is poorly understood.
We introduce tree-grams in light of the above considerations.
Detailed background and related works are presented in Appendix B .

这种分级建模的理由来自统计属性分析(Thurner等人,2015年),信息理论(Futrell and Hahn,2026年;Yang等人,2026年)和
认知表达(Crain和中山,1987年;Pallier等人,2011年;Ding等人,2016年;Hale等人,2018年).
然而,所有这类模型都根据语义结构或合成结构固定隐藏特征.
树克作为基因模型被引入,其中隐藏的节点特征直接从数据中学习.

blocks.en:
In order to understand the performance gap of tree-grams to LLMs more carefully, we compare tree-grams with transformers of different depth with the same parameter count , the same context length and trained with the same number of optimization steps , thereby highlighting the difference in their architectural biases.
For each tree-gram target, we take a decoder-only transformer of depth L ∈ { 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 10 , 12 } L\in\{1,2,3,4,5,6,10,12\} .
Tree-grams perform better than the shallow matched transformers. This pattern holds until approximately n = 8 n=8 .
At longer contexts, the tree-gram is unable to match deep transformers.
The right panel shows that the excess loss monotonically decreases with d d .
While shallow transformers plateau quickly, tree-grams monotonically decrease with a power-law curve, showing that they are more scalable than shallow transformers.
In addition, the slope is not drastically different from the deepest transformers tested.
It is worth emphasizing that this performance gap could simply be due to sub-optimal optimization routines for tree-grams.
Developing better principles for optimizing tree-grams is left for future work.

blocks.en:
We use the tree-grams as a source of synthetic data, with n n and d d independently controlling distinct modes of approximation of the synthetic corpus to the original training corpus.
We emphasize that, unlike transformers, a single hyper-parameter d d controls the model capacity.
In Appendix M we present a qualitative analysis of the decoded text generated by tree-grams from the same prompt.
Increasing n n (at sufficiently large d d ) increases coherence from word-level ( n = 3 n=3 ) to sentence-level ( n = 32 n=32 ).
On the other hand, increasing d d increases both coherence and quality of the generated text.
We demonstrate the scientific utility of such finite-window and finite-capacity approximations by experimenting on hyper-parameter transfer under μ \mu P and effect of pre-training and fine-tuning distribution shifts on fine-tuning performance.

However, the complexity of the datasets in the tuning phase is only controlled implicitly, for example through the amount of pre-training data Bjorck et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2025) , data deduplication Lee et al. (2022) ; Abbas et al. (2023) or high-quality data pruning Sorscher et al. (2023) .

Using tree-grams as a generative model, we can control the data complexity explicitly.
We observe that tuning HPs on a controlled-complexity approximation of the original dataset yields better transfer.
Specifically, we tune the learning rate of 2- and 4-layer μ \mu P decoder-only proxy transformers with widths d ∈ { 64 , … , 256 } d\in\{64,\dots,256\} , then analyze the transfer to target transformers with various widths.
We judge the transfer by the excess loss of the target model with transferred learning rate with respect to its own HP-tuned minimum.
As shown in Figure 3 , tuning ν ⋆ \nu^{\star} on the original data almost always yields the highest excess loss (black square).
The converged loss has an asymmetric dependence around the optimal learning Kosson et al. (2026) ; Ishikawa et al. (2026) ; Filatov et al. (2025) .
Thus, a drift in the optimal learning rate can lead to a higher excess loss. We show empirical evidence for this drift in Figure 3 .
The ν ⋆ \nu^{\star} from tuning on the real dataset however shows a non-monotonic effect with width, as shown by the black dashed line which sits lower than the optimal learning rate obtained from tuning on the real data.
While a formal characterization of which proxy distribution to tune on, remains an open question - choosing the median learning rate over different proxy distributions can give robust transfer.
It is worth emphasizing that the undershooting the learning rate is better only if the optimal learning rate at a narrower width is higher than that at larger width.
In the Appendix, we show that this does not hold for FineWeb-Edu. The monotonic drift in optimal learning rate as a function of data complexity however still holds, which is the relevant phenomena.

blocks.en:
The value of a pre-training distribution depends on how well it aligns with the fine-tuning distribution. ( Isik et al., 2025 ) find that downstream quality improves monotonically with more pre-training data only when the two distributions are well aligned.
Synthetic corpora have been used to ask which structure transfers to natural language: music and code ( Papadimitriou and Jurafsky, 2020 ) , artificial languages with controlled dependency structure ( Ri and Tsuruoka, 2022 ; Chiang and Lee, 2022 ) , and formal languages with hierarchical dependencies ( Hu et al., 2025 ) can all transfer, depending on the structure they carry.
Tree-grams provide a structured manner to introduce, and to measure, misalignment between the pre-training and finetuning data, through either the context horizon n n or the model capacity d d .

Figure 5 reports the result of this experiment.
The final finetuning performance depends monotonically on the complexity of the finetuning distribution.
The dependence on the pre-training distribution is more nuanced. If the pre-training data is too simple , we notice a monotonic worsening of performance with decreasing complexity.
However, when fine-tuning distributions are simple, finetuning performance is almost independent of the pre-training distribution.
Note that we separate the capacity-limited and horizon-limited modes Figure 5 .
This is because the monotonicity is a function of the entropy of the distribution within the same approximation mode (the figure sorted by entropy alone is reported in Appendix I , where the clean trend shown disappears.)
Most of the gap is set by the target, through two properties that can be measured directly from its token statistics: its entropy rate and the effective range of correlations,
measured by how quickly the mutual information between tokens decays with their separation, beyond the horizon. Entropy has the larger effect, but at comparable entropy a target
with a longer effective range is consistently harder to reach.
The joint effect of entropy and effective range of correlations was discussed in Cagnetta et al. (2026) .
We propose an ad hoc four-parameter law in these two quantities, plus a penalty when the source carries less information than the target, which accounts for 82–99% of the variance across all source–target pairs
in every setting, and predicts the gap for held-out targets. Details are delegated to Appendix J .

We focus on three kinds of topologies: aligned, balanced, and anti-aligned. 8 8 8 This naming convention comes from the hypothesis that English language is predominantly right-branching Berg (2012) . We emphasize that we do not test the validity of this assumption. The aligned topologies contain all connections on the left-hand side (topologies labelled τ 0 \tau_{0} , τ 1 , τ 2 \tau_{1},\tau_{2} in Figure 6 ), while the anti-aligned topologies contain all connections on the right-hand side (labelled τ − 1 \tau_{-1} , τ − 2 \tau_{-2} ). Balanced topologies have the connections in the middle (labelled τ a \tau_{a} , τ b \tau_{b} ).
With proper hyper-parameter tuning, all seven converge to nearly the same loss at the end of training.
The difference in their per-token losses occurs only in the last few positions.
We notice that the balanced and aligned topologies typically have a higher loss, while the anti-aligned topologies converge to a lower last-token loss.
However, we perform experiments with τ 0 \tau_{0} since it is an interpretable model, as outlined in Section 6 .
There is some difference in the training dynamics , which is reported in Fig. 6 . The anti-aligned topologies start at a higher loss but converge to a lower loss and vice versa for the algined topologies.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion, Limitations, Future Work
blocks.zh: 7 结论、限制、今后的工作

blocks.en:
In this work, we present tree-grams, trainable and controllable n n -gram approximators of language. They match optimal n n -gram estimates at small n n . A noticeable gap from deep models remains at longer contexts.
We find that controlled data approximations can aid hyper-parameter transfer under μ \mu P. We also use them to study performance gaps after finetuning by distinguishing pre-training and fine-tuning distributions.

我们发现,控制数据近似可帮助在μ \ mu P下进行超参数传输。 我们还通过区分预训和微调分配,在微调后研究性能差距.

blocks.en:
Since the focus in this work was experimental rather than empirical, our work consequently suffers from many limitations.
It is not obvious whether our choice of architecture is optimal.
We consider a narrow class of topologies, which is fixed by the layer recurrence relation 3 and the maximal order of the Merge \operatorname{Merge} operation. We implement a particular choice of tensor factorization in 5 , inspired from Loconte and others (2024) .
Computational constraints prevent scaling to longer context windows, particularly to n ≈ 256 n\approx 256 , which is the typical length of paragraphs in TinyStories. The O ⁡ ( B ​ n 2 ​ d ) O(Bn^{2}d) activation cost of prefix unfolding is a primary bottleneck, which could be reduced by sharing prefix states.
In addition, the scope and scale of the models and data is limited.
Understanding of different individual components of the tree-gram architecture also remains limited.
In addition, a careful comparison of alternate HP tuning strategies was not performed.

对树格图架构不同组成部分的理解也仍然有限。

blocks.en:
Developing faster, stabler and robust optimization routines for tree-grams remains an open engineering problem.
It would also be interesting to train tree-grams on distributions very different from language.
We leave these and other directions mentioned in the text for future work.

blocks.en: Appendix B Detailed Background and Related Works
blocks.zh: 附录B 详细背景和有关著作

blocks.en: We provide a detailed description of previous and related works, to motivate tree-grams presented in this work.
blocks.zh: 我们详细描述了以前和相关的工作,以激励这项工作中提出的树标。

blocks.en:
Modelling language has been an area of study for a long time.
The classic work of ( Chomsky, 1956 ) used finite-state Markov models, phrase-structure grammars and transformational grammars.
The theory of formal languages classifies grammars by their generative capacity ( Chomsky, 1959 ) . In particular, context-free grammars use recursive production rules to generate hierarchical and nested structures, such as Dyck languages, that finite-state Markov models cannot represent ( Chomsky and Schützenberger, 1963 ) .
Later work extended context-free grammars into stochastic models by assigning probabilities to production rules ( Booth, 1969 ; Lari and Young, 1990 ) , while synthetic grammatical data became a controlled setting for studying whether neural networks can learn hierarchical structure ( Elman, 1991 ) .
More recently, there has been a growing interest in understanding models of data with randomly chosen underlying rules, eg. the Random Language Model ( DeGiuli, 2019 ) and the Random Hierarchy Model ( Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) .
The justification for such hierarchical structures comes from theoretical studies ( Chomsky, 1957 ) , statistical analysis ( Thurner et al., 2015 ; Goodfellow et al., 2016 ) , information theory ( Futrell and Hahn, 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) and
cognitive representations ( Crain and Nakayama, 1987 ; Pallier et al., 2011 ; Ding et al., 2016 ; Hale et al., 2018 ) .
Tree-grams are a natural extension of such hierarchical and exponentially expressive models of language-like data. By making these models trainable, we allow tree-grams to capture necessary features from the data, without explicit interpretation of hidden nodes.
blocks.zh:
建模语言长期以来一直是研究领域.
经典的作品(乔姆斯基,1956年)使用了有限状态的马尔科夫模型,短语结构语法和变形语法.
正式语言的理论将语法根据其基因能力分类(乔姆斯基,1959年). 特别是,无上下文语法使用递归性生产规则来产生等级和巢状结构,如Dyck语言,有限状态的Markov模型不能代表(Chomsky和Schützenberger,1963年).
后来的工作通过给生产规则分配概率(Booth,1969年;Lari and Young,1990年),将无上下文语法扩展为分层模型,而合成语法数据则成为研究神经网络能否学习等级结构的可控设置(Elman,1991年).
最近,人们越来越有兴趣用随机选择的基本规则来理解数据模型,如随机语言模型(DeGiuli,2019年)和随机等级模型(Cagnetta等人,2024年)。
此类等级结构的理由来自理论研究(Chomsky,1957年),统计分析(Thurner等人,2015年;Goodfellow等人,2016年),信息理论(Futrell and Hahn,2026年;Yang等人,2026年)和.
认知表达(Crain和中山,1987年;Pallier等人,2011年;Ding等人,2016年;Hale等人,2018年).
树格法是这种等级化和指数化的表达式语言类数据模型的自然延伸. 通过使这些模型可以训练,我们允许树克从数据中捕捉到必要的特征,而不明确解释隐藏的节点.

blocks.en:
n n -gram estimators provide a truncated-horizon approximation of language data.
In addition, several model families introduce monotonic measures of capacity.
Weighted automata uses finite Hankel rank ( Denis et al., 2016 ) .
MPS uses bond dimension ( Pestun and Vlassopoulos, 2017 ; Miller et al., 2021 ; Su et al., 2024 ) ( Yang et al., 2021 ) uses latent state size, while ( Parikh et al., 2014a ) use matrix and tensor ranks to represent intermediate levels of dependence between successive n n -gram orders.

n-gram 估计器提供了语言数据的截断-视距近似值.
此外,几个模范家庭引入了能力单调度量法.
Wighted automata使用有限的汉克尔等级(Denis等人,2016年).
MPS使用债券维度(Pestun和Vlassopoulos,2017年;Miller等人,2021年;Su等人,2024年)(Yang等人,2021年)使用潜在状态大小,而(Parikh等人,2014年a)使用矩阵和拉诺级来代表连续n-gm命令之间的依赖程度中间.

blocks.en:
There have been attempts to study transformers on synthetic formal grammars.
In addition, n n -gram models of data has also been formulated
as a learning problem by ( Svete et al., 2024 ) and ( Varre et al., 2025 ) in an in-context setting. ( Yüksel et al., 2026 ) show that transformer incremental learn higher order Markov structure.
However, to the best of our knowledge, such controlled approximations have never been applied for understanding practical situations like HP transfer, due to the limitation posed by scalability and fidelity to a realistic text corpora.
blocks.zh:
曾有人尝试研究合成形式语法的变压器.
此外,还制定了n-gm数据模型。
由(Svete等人,2024年)和(Varre等人,2025年)在一个内文环境中作为一个学习问题。 (Yüksel 等人,2026年)显示变压器增量学习更高的马可夫结构.
然而,据我们所知,由于可伸缩性和忠诚性对现实文本corpora的限制,这种可控近似物从未用于理解HP转移等实际情况。

blocks.en:
Differentiable tree structures exist.
In particular, Tree-LSTMs consume a given parse ( Tai et al., 2015 ) while ( Choi et al., 2018 ) learns the composition order (tree) with a Gümbel relaxation. ( Shen et al., 2019 ) forces a soft hierarchy into a recurrent net’s gates.
A key tension arises with ( Williams et al., 2018 ) , who caution that the structures such models learn need not be the linguistically meaningful ones.
Transformer architectures also take advantage of trees, eg. ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) uses a decision-tree index over keys.

可区分的树结构存在.
特别是,树-LSTMs消耗一个给定的剖面(Tai等人,2015年),而(Choi等人,2018年)则用Gümbel放松来学习成分顺序(树). (沈等,2019年) 迫使柔性等级制进入经常网门.

blocks.en: Appendix D Description of n n -gram baselines used for comparison
blocks.zh: 附录D 用于比较的n-g基线说明

blocks.en:
A raw count n n -gram model estimates p ( x n ∣ x 1 : n − 1 ) p(x_{n}\mid x_{1:n-1}) by normalizing counts for each observed n n -tuple of tokens.
Smoothed raw count models redistribute probability mass to unseen events and shorter histories through interpolation and absolute discounting, while low-rank ensembles control the correlation of n n -grams through low-rank matrices ( Chen and Goodman, 1996 ; Parikh et al., 2014b ) .
We report classical raw-count, smoothed-count, and low-rank count baselines only for n = 2 n=2 to n = 8 n=8 .
This is because at n = 8 n=8 , we already observe that 60% of the n n -grams appear only once.
Tree-grams match these tested count baselines at small n n and out-perform them for larger n n .

Infini-gram uses a suffix array to retrieve continuation counts for the longest matching suffix of the available history and backs off when longer matches are unavailable ( Liu et al., 2025 ) .
In our finite-context comparison, we cap this search at n − 1 n-1 tokens and interpolate with a smoothed unigram ( infinigram + unigram )
or a neural LM ( infinigram + neural LM )
. On TinyStories, infinigram + unigram improves through n = 4 n=4 , but its loss worsens and then plateaus at larger n n as long exact suffix matches become rare.
Infinigram + neural LM improves but plateaus by n ≈ 8 n\approx 8 .
In contrast, tree-grams improve throughout the tested range and outperform infinigram at every shared value of n n .

Infini-gram 使用后缀阵列来获取可用历史中最长的匹配后缀的续数,当无法进行更长的匹配时则回转(Liu等人,2025年).
在我们的有限文本比较中,我们以n - 1 n - 1 令牌为搜索上限,并用一个平滑的unigram(infinigram + unigram )插上
或神经LM(infinigram + 神经LM)

Infinigram + 神经LM 改善但高原 = n = = 8 n\\ 约 8 .
与此相反,树克在整个试验范围内都有改善,并且以每个共值n n 的单位值超过了单位值。

blocks.en:
A spectral weighted-finite-automaton ( spectral WFA ) estimator constructs empirical Hankel blocks of substring probabilities and uses a truncated singular-value decomposition to recover a finite-dimensional state and token-transition operators ( Balle et al., 2014 ) .
After tuning the rank and Hankel window W ∈ { 3 , … , 6 } W\in\{3,\ldots,6\} , the resulting curve remains nearly flat as n n increases and performs worse even compared to the raw trigram.
Tree-grams outperform the spectral estimator at every shared order, with the gap increasing toward larger n n .
blocks.zh:
一个光谱加权-无限-自离子(光谱WFA)估计器构建了经验性的汉克尔区块的底弦概率,并使用短线单值分解来恢复有限维态和符号过渡操作员(Balle等人,2014年)。
在调整等级和汉克尔窗口 W { { 3, ..., 6 } W\in\ 3,\ ldots, 6} 之后,产生的曲线随着n n 的增加而保持了近乎平坦的状态,甚至与生三克相比表现更差.
树克在每一个共享顺序上都超过了光谱估计器,差距逐渐加大到更大的n n.

blocks.en:
We compare to three tensor-network language models. The uniform matrix product state ( u-MPS ) of ( Miller et al., 2021 ) is a Born machine, p ( x n ∣ x 1 : n − 1 ) ∝ | α ⊤ A x 1 ⋯ A x n ω | 2 p(x_{n}\mid x_{1:n-1})\propto|\alpha^{\top}A^{x_{1}}\cdots A^{x_{n}}\omega|^{2} , with a single core A ∈ ℝ | V | × D × D A\in\mathbb{R}^{|V|\times D\times D} shared across positions. The tree tensor network ( tree TN ) of ( Cheng et al., 2019 ) is a Born machine on a balanced binary tree over the context, with a learned | V | → v |V|\to v feature map at the leaves and one order-3 tensor at each internal node; we train it end to end by gradient descent rather than by DMRG sweeps. TTLM-Large ( TTLM ) ( Su et al., 2024 ) is a tensor-train recurrence in which a token-dependent factor updates the state multiplicatively, followed by a softmax readout tied to the input embedding tensor.
At every n n , the bond dimension D D , the tree width v v and the rank R R are set to match the parameter count of the d = 1024 d=1024 tree-gram ( D = 47 D=47 – 131 131 , v = 164 v=164 – 316 316 , R = 46 R=46 – 128 128 ). The tree TN is best at n = 3 n=3 ( 3.36 3.36 nats) and falls to near the unigram level from n = 8 n=8 on. Tree-grams outperform all three at every shared order, by 0.19 0.19 nats at n = 3 n=3 and 0.95 0.95 nats at n = 32 n=32 against the strongest of them, TTLM.

blocks.en:
A neural n n -gram model embeds a fixed window of n − 1 n-1 preceding tokens and uses an MLP with a softmax output to estimate the next-token distribution. This may be done with one-hot encodings ( Castro et al., 1999 ) ( MLP ) or through learnable embedding structure ( Bengio et al., 2003b ) ( neural LM ).
Later works combined MLP with a unigram model ( Blat et al., 2005 ) which we adapt here as the MLP + unigram model with the learnable embedding MLP.
The parameter-matched neural baseline improves through n = 16 n=16 but worsens at n = 32 n=32 . However, it has consistently higher cross-entropy than tree-grams.
Thus, tree-grams outperform all tested finite-window neural n n -gram estimators at every shared order.
blocks.zh:
神经n-gram模型嵌入一个固定的窗口n−1n-1在符前,并使用具有软max输出的MLP来估计下一个托肯分布. 可采用单热编码(Castro等人,1999年)(MLP)或通过可学习的嵌入结构(Bengio等人,2003年b)(神经LM)。
后来的作品将 MLP 与 unigram 模型(Blat et al., 2005)结合,我们在这里作为 MLP + unigram 模型与 可学习的嵌入 MLP 进行适应.
参数匹配的神经基线通过n=16n=16改善,但在n=32n=32时恶化. 然而,它的跨度一直高于树克。
因此,树克在每种共享顺序上都超过了所有经过测试的有限窗口神经元n-gm估计器.

blocks.en:
Well-trained deep sequence models provide a stronger estimate of n n -gram statistics at large n n ( Nguyen, 2024 ; Krishnan et al., 2023 ; Cagnetta et al., 2026 ) .
In this case, we compare tree-grams to GPT-2 with absolute positional embeddings ( GPT-2 (APE) ) and rotary positional embeddings ( GPT-2 (RoPE) ), Llama-3.2 ( Llama ), and Mamba ( Mamba ).
These are converged multi-epoch runs, which use approximately six times the token budget.
In Fig. 1 b, tree-grams track these estimators through approximately n = 8 n=8 , while the deep references remain lower at larger n n .
However, in Fig. 1 (c), cross-entropy decreases monotonically as the rank d d increases over the tested range.

在这种情况下,我们用绝对位置嵌入(GPT-2 (APE))和旋转位置嵌入(GPT-2 (ROPE)),Llama-3.2 (Llama)和Mamba (Mamba) 来比较树格和GPT-2。

blocks.en: We provide details of the toy model that we defined in the main text, which suggests a plausible mechanism for the HP transfer experiment results we observe empirically.
blocks.zh: 我们详细介绍了我们在正文中定义的玩具模型,该模型为我们的经验观测到的HP转移实验结果建议了一个可行的机制。

blocks.en:
This model is based primarily on the random hierarchy model ( Cagnetta et al., 2024 ) and the wavelet analysis of ( Wornell and Oppenheim, 1992a ; Mallat, 1989 ) . The toy model for the data has two layers.
A finite dyadic hierarchy allocates predictive power across look-back scales.
A Gaussian channel limits how well each latent feature can be recovered.
Each of these layers are used to implement a different mode of control that tree-grams offer. We discuss this in more detail below.
We make an attempt to highlight every assumption that a conclusion depends on through the labels (A1) – (A10).
Figure 8 gives an intuitive picture.

有限的分级分配了整个回望尺度的预测力。
一个高斯通道限制了每个潜在特性的恢复程度。
每一层都用于执行树克提供的一种不同的控制模式。 我们将在下文更详细地讨论这一点。
我们试图强调通过标签(A1)—(A10)得出结论的每一个假设。

blocks.en:
Tree-grams were trained on WikiText-103 (130 MT) and FineWeb-Edu (1.05BT subset) as well. The training was done by choosing the best hyper-parameter for the relevant models for the TinyStories corpus, without additional hyper-parameter tuning.
Training time was approximately linear in total token count, except for the n = 32 , d = 1024 n=32,d=1024 tree-gram model which could not be fit into 4 A100 GPUs. As a result we used gradient accumulation, which made the total wall-clock time to be closer to 20 hours, rather than the expected 10 hours.
The additional experiments reported for these datasets needed an additional 8,000 GPU hours. At the time of writing, the pre-training, fine-tuning results on FineWeb-Edu are yet to run, and they need an estimated 2,000 GPU hours more.

blocks.en:
We timed the generation costs for the largest generators in the paper: 139.5 million parameters over an 8,192-token vocabulary (TinyStories and WikiText) and 182.6 million parameters over a 50,257-token vocabulary (FineWeb-Edu).
On four threads of a single CPU (an Apple M4 Pro), sampling 512 sequences in parallel, they produce about 1.15 thousand and 0.65 thousand tokens per second.
Generating WikiText (131.8 million tokens), TinyStories (529.2 million) and FineWeb-Edu (1.05 billion) therefore takes about 32, 128 and 448 hours on one worker.
The deepest KV-cached transformers typically take around 2x less time for generation.

因此,生成维基文库(1.318亿令牌),TinyStories(5.292亿)和FineWeb-Edu(10.5亿)需要约32,128和448小时的工人.

blocks.en: Which source–target pairs are hard to fine-tune is decided almost entirely by the target , through two properties measured directly on its token statistics. The first is its entropy rate: targets with a lower Bayes floor are harder to reach relative to that floor. The second is its effective range , which is how far apart two tokens can be and still carry information about each other. Entropy has the larger effect, but at comparable entropy a target with a longer effective range is consistently harder to reach. Generators that change the width at a fixed window sit above generators that change the window, at the same entropy (Fig. 18 , top). The source matters mainly when it carries less information than the target. A four-parameter law in these quantities, linear in the target’s entropy and in the logarithm of its range, plus a penalty for a source whose entropy rate exceeds the target’s, accounts for 82–99% of the variance across all 81 source–target pairs in each setting. It predicts the gap for held-out targets with comparable error (Fig. 18 , bottom). The range term has the same sign and nearly the same size in all four settings.

blocks.en: To measure the effective range, we estimate the mutual information between two tokens k k positions apart in text sampled from each generator. We use a bias-corrected plug-in estimator and subtract a null computed on shuffled pairs. Beyond the generator’s context window ( k > n k>n ), the logarithm of this mutual information falls linearly with k k , so the information decays exponentially. We take the slope of that line, k eff k_{\rm eff} , as the decay rate, so a small | k eff | |k_{\rm eff}| means a long range. Each curve is fitted only up to the lag where the mutual information first falls into the noise floor of the estimator. For display, the top row labels each target with its mean lag k ¯ \bar{k} , the lag averaged with weights given by the mutual information, which orders the targets the same way.

blocks.en: Appendix K Effective Receptive Fields for Tree-grams
blocks.zh: 附录 K 树克的有效受体域

blocks.en:
The aligned topology labelled τ 0 \tau_{0} (Figure 6 ) has the unique property that terminal nodes in different layers ”focus” on different parts of the context. On the other hand, the anti-aligned topology τ − 1 \tau_{-1} mixes information from the whole context.
We use a linear probe to uncover input tokens from latent activations of the terminal nodes in tree-grams.
We observe that for τ 0 \tau_{0} , different terminal nodes in different layers recover each input token in its scope.
The accuracy rises as we move down the layers, which indicates the difficulty of reconstruction increases as we pass through multiple non-linear passes.
In contrast, for τ − 1 \tau_{-1} and transformers, recovery peaks at the last token, given the full context.
This highlights that the aligned topology has effective receptive fields for each node in the downward pass, in contrast with anti-aligned topologies and transformers.
Activation patching also confirms this causally (Fig. 19 ). Restoring a single node recovers the prediction exactly when the swapped token lies in its scope and not at all otherwise.
We emphasize that we do not claim that transformers are implementing a τ − 1 \tau_{-1} topology. Recovery of trees from transformers needs careful investigation due to known biasing effects from the parsing algorithm, feature definition as well as inherent architectural biases ( Li et al., 2020 ) .
In addition, we contrast this token recovery pattern in four different network ablations: trained and untrained tree-grams with or without residual connections (Fig. 20 ).
The windowed receptive fields of τ 0 \tau_{0} are already present in an untrained tree-gram with residual connections: each terminal node recovers the tokens in its scope above the majority-class baseline at initialization, so the windows come from the wiring of the topology rather than from training. Training sharpens these windows and removes the leakage of the earliest tokens into the lower nodes.
Residual connections are what carry token identity through depth. Without them, an untrained tree-gram loses the tokens that pass through more than a few merges, and a trained one keeps the narrow windows near the end of the context but loses most of the wide early ones. τ − 1 \tau_{-1} shows no windows in any of the four conditions: untrained, its nodes hold a weak, nearly uniform trace of the whole context, and trained, all of them peak at the last token.
We emphasize that the purpose of these experiments were to show that τ 0 \tau_{0} and τ − 1 \tau_{-1} provide alternate mechanisms for model computation. The corresponding experiments with transformers show that this is distinct from the usual model computation, which are closer to the anti-aligned topology τ − 1 \tau_{-1} as opposed to τ 0 \tau_{0} .
